aggregate.rule: 09 item 35: S = the six-probe mean of the run-mean Delta_full, item 24's delta rule (|(planted - unplanted) - delta| <= 0.5|delta| AND the planted 95% interval excludes the unplanted point); the EXCESS (mean G - mean Y; the plant shifts each probe's signed gaps, G = 0.5|sim - run1| + 0.5|sim - run2| is recomputed, Y = |run2@B - run1@B| at the pooled tau_B (RULE 45.1; gap run2_minus_run1_at_tauB) is unchanged): Delta_exp = excess(planted, draw 0) - excess(unplanted, draw 0); DETECTED iff |bootstrap-mean move - Delta_exp| <= 0.5|Delta_exp| AND the planted 95% interval excludes the unplanted point; |Delta_exp| < 0.5 points -> 'not testable at this delta'
